overview: Crafting stations gate what tier of gear, food or blueprint you can produce. Most stations upgrade through 2-4 tiers, each unlocked via a Memetic Specialization purchased in the Cradle (the memetic tree) using Cipher + Meme Points, then built once you have the listed materials.

weaponAndGearStations.name: Gear Workbench
weaponAndGearStations.unlock: Unlock 'Essential Tools' then the Gear Workbench branch in the Memetics menu.
weaponAndGearStations.produces: Tier I-II weapons and armor (given the blueprint + materials).

weaponAndGearStations.name: Intermediate Gear Workbench
weaponAndGearStations.unlock: Upgrade memetic purchased after the base Gear Workbench line.

weaponAndGearStations.name: Advanced Gear Workbench
weaponAndGearStations.unlock: Requires Symbiosis level VIII; purchase via the Cradle, Crafting page '05 Enlightenment' (7 Cipher, 2000 Meme Points).
weaponAndGearStations.produces: Tier V weapons and armor (top tier), plus all lower tiers.

weaponAndGearStations.name: Designer's Workstation
weaponAndGearStations.unlock: Building branch of the Memetic menu.
weaponAndGearStations.produces: Disassembles unwanted/duplicate blueprints into Formula Blueprint Fragments, redeemable for new blueprints.

cookingStations.name: Stove
cookingStations.produces: Basic dishes (Roasted Meat, Grilled Fish, breads, simple soups).

cookingStations.name: Electric Stove
cookingStations.unlock: Unlock Dishes I, Air-Drying and Dishes II first, then the Electric Stove memetic via the Cradle, Logistics page '03 Ascendance' at Symbiosis level IV (3 Cipher, 200 Meme Points).

cookingStations.name: Refrigerator
cookingStations.produces: Extends food shelf life; required for certain legendary recipes.

cookingStations.name: Integrated Kitchen / Kitchen Set
cookingStations.unlock: Requires the Refrigeration memetic first, then Integrated Kitchen via the Cradle, Logistics category tier 4 (5 Cipher, 700 Meme Points).
cookingStations.produces: The best cooking station in the game — unlocks Caviar and Butter as ingredients plus the Kitchen Set blueprint (which unlocks the Advanced Stove and further recipes).

otherStations.name: Planter Box
otherStations.produces: Grows crops from seeds — see the Crops & Ranching section.
otherStations.upgrade: Planter Box: Greenhouse Planting memetic increases growth speed/yield per temperature degree.

otherStations.name: Isolated Securement Unit
otherStations.produces: Houses a captured Deviant so its ability becomes active — see the Deviants section.

otherStations.name: Youngling Hut
otherStations.produces: Where bred livestock offspring grow up — see the Crops & Ranching section.
